facts.text: The words "Major League Hacking" were printed under the MLH letters.
A person in dark clothes was lying on the floor by the wall.
Two small signs with red lettering lay on top of the long table.
A second blue table next to it had small cards and papers spread out.
The floor was dark concrete with cracks in it.
The walls behind the table were plain and white.
A blue tablecloth said "Hardware Lab" in white letters.
The tablecloth had big "MLH" letters in red, blue and yellow, with "Major League Hacking" underneath.
Three boxes were stacked at the end of the table: white on top, red in the middle, yellow at the bottom.
A person in dark clothes was lying on the floor by the wall on the left.
A second blue table beside it held stacks of cards and small papers.
Two small signs with red writing lay on top of the blue table.
The floor was dark, worn concrete.
The walls behind the table were plain white.

sessions.note: They didn't say anything during this session.
